description: Untappd isn't just a check-in social network. It's a public beer intelligence layer: global ratings, style, ABV, IBU, and check-in volume that agents can query without the closed official API.

tools.name: beer_get
tools.description: Fetch a public beer page by numeric id (301s to /b/{slug}/{id}) or pass a slug path. Required: id. Returns the Beer.

params.name: id
params.description: Untappd beer id or slug (e.g. 4384886 or hop-butcher-for-the-world-cool-bay).

tools.name: beer_search
tools.description: Search public beers via Untappd's frontend Algolia index (search-only key published on untappd.com/search). Required: query. Optional: hitsPerPage (default: 10). Returns array of BeerSearchHit.

tools.name: brewery_beers
tools.description: List beers on a public brewery beer page, including ratings when present. Required: slug. Returns array of BeerListItem.

tools.name: brewery_get
tools.description: Fetch a public brewery page by numeric id (redirects to /{slug}) or slug. Required: id. Returns the Brewery.

params.name: id
params.description: Untappd brewery id or slug (e.g. 23570 or HopButcher).

tools.name: brewery_search
tools.description: Search public breweries via Untappd's frontend Algolia index. Required: query. Optional: hitsPerPage (default: 10). Returns array of BrewerySearchHit.
